note: Documented limits and Studio limits are distinct from account RPM/TPM. The Models API returns IDs rather than parameter schemas or billing balances.

images.label: Images
images.notes: Select model, quality and planning effort in chat for each request. Planning effort (complexity) is distinct from output quality; default omits the parameter. GPT Image 2 supports auto/low/medium/high quality, not xhigh/max. Edits accept 1-16 ordered PNG/JPEG/WebP references, each at most 25 MiB and 100 MiB combined. An optional PNG mask is smaller than 4 MB, matches the first reference and applies to it. Studio caps prompt length at 32,000 characters and output count at 10. Model support varies.

speech.label: Speech synthesis
speech.notes: Choose model and voice in chat per request; no reasoning-effort setting. Speech input: up to 4,096 characters. Speed: 0.25-4. Formats: wav, mp3, opus, aac, flac, pcm. Voice and delivery-instruction support depend on the model. PCM is saved as raw audio.

transcription.label: Transcription
transcription.notes: Studio saves a JSON transcription response as text and accepts an optional two-letter language code. Diarization-specific options are not implemented; choose a general transcription model for the existing tool. Studio accepts files up to 25 MiB; provider limits also apply.

video.label: Video, reference only
video.notes: OpenAI documents Sora 2 and the Videos API as shut down on 24 September 2026, with no one-to-one API replacement. Historical parameters were 4/8/12 seconds and 720x1280, 1280x720, 1024x1792 or 1792x1024. Listing an ID does not prove that video generation is usable. No video generation tools are added.

responses.label: Text / Responses candidates
responses.notes: Choose model and reasoning effort in chat for each request. Explicit effort default omits the API option; other values require model support. Studio's output cap is 16-128,000 tokens; model limits may differ. Verbosity is per request and omitted when blank. Bulk text runs sequentially with store=false.

realtime.label: Realtime / Live, reference only
realtime.notes: These models need their own streaming/session APIs. Studio's saved speech and transcription defaults do not configure a Realtime or Live session.

audio_other.label: Other audio, reference only
audio_other.notes: Audio chat models are not automatically compatible with the Speech API or transcription API. Check the model's endpoint documentation before choosing a default.

embeddings.label: Embeddings, reference only
embeddings.notes: Listed for discovery. Studio currently has no embedding generation tool.

moderation.label: Moderation, reference only
moderation.notes: Listed for discovery. Studio currently has no moderation execution tool.

other.label: Other / legacy / unclassified
other.notes: An ID in the list does not identify its supported endpoint. Legacy completion or chat-only models may not work with Studio's Responses tool.

gpt-6.2-sol.status: Documented model; use returned list for key discovery
gpt-6.2-sol.notes: The API rejects reasoning effort none for this model.

gpt-6.1-terra.status: Documented model; use returned list for key discovery
gpt-6.1-terra.notes: Documented reasoning efforts: none, low, medium (default), high, xhigh, max. Tool calling requires Responses.

gpt-image-2.5-sunburst.status: Documented model; use returned list for key discovery
gpt-image-2.5-sunburst.notes: Documented quality choices include low, medium, high, xhigh, max and auto.

gpt-image-2.6-sunburst.status: Documented model; use returned list for key discovery
gpt-image-2.6-sunburst.notes: Studio supports complexity (planning effort). Markup-guided edits, SVG and animated GIF output modes are not implemented by Studio.

gpt-transcribe.status: Documented model; use returned list for key discovery
gpt-transcribe.notes: Completed audio files, streamed file transcripts and committed Realtime turns are documented. Studio uses completed files only.
